category_edits.rationale: Halve the configured maximum history length, with a minimum of one interaction, to reduce stale context and recurrent computation across all four datasets. Existing truncation retains the newest events in chronological order. Saved maxlen metadata automatically applies the same context limit in the generated predictor, preserving the GRU, embeddings, readout, loss, and optimizer.

response.change_summary: Reduce default causal history length from 128 to 64 consistently during training, validation, and prediction.
